items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Someone sold me a planet for $20, a Henry Farney. I haven't heard the name, it's Paris. I haven't heard the name before or since.

ctx.x: He said, that's all right. Yeah, that's no kidding.

I said, I don't know why, but it did. I had a good boss, because I was squeaking and squawking on that thing on the job. He let me use it, you know. Someone sold me a planet for $20, a Henry Farney. I haven't heard the name, it's Paris. I haven't heard the name before or since. It was hot. That's how come you pick up that thing.
